news.headline: Foreign media were granted rare visas to cover Khamenei’s funeral. Here’s what our reporter saw.
news.summary: A regime that has survived months of attack by the United States and Israel is projecting a show of strength with enormous crowds and the reappearance of military leaders.

news.headline: Djokovic wins five-hour epic to earn Sinner showdown at Wimbledon
news.summary: Gauff defeats Pegula to set up semifinal against Muchova, who overcame four-time Grand Slam champion Osaka.
